newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq gets lift from Microsoft, little else.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq gets lift from Microsoft, little else.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks finished higher on Friday as strong earnings from market giant Microsoft Corp lifted the Nasdaq composite index but failed to ignite a broad high-technology rally.
Microsoft "carried itself but it didn't carry anything else," said Brett Discher, vice president of equity trading at Dain Bosworth.
The Nasdaq composite rose 5-1/2 points to 1223, but finished below its session peak of 1233.
Microsoft reported third quarter earnings of $0.79 a share Thursday after the close of trading, well above consensus forecasts of $0.64 a share. It finished up 9-1/2 to 107-5/8.
But traders said investors remained cautious toward high technology stocks, particularily ahead of next Wednesday's quarterly earnings report from bellwether International Business Machines Corp.
Intel Corp fell 7/8 to 137-1/8 and Dell Computer Corp dropped 5/8 to 76-3/8.
IDEXX Laboratories Inc fell 2-2/16 to 9-15/16. It reported a drop in first quarter earnings and said its second quarter results were unlikely to top the first quarter.
